svg.title: One lifecycle, two tracks
svg.desc: Nine lifecycle stages in four phases, three gates, what the three functions do in each phase, and what runs across the whole lifecycle.
svg.text: Assets that produce outcomes take the full track: nine stages, three gates, three separate functions. The building blocks they use take a shorter component track through the same stages.
